blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite significant advances in computer vision, semantic segmentation models remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks, posing a security risk. These attacks redirect pixels of a chosen victim class to an attacker-specified target class when a trigger is present, while preserving clean predictions. Existing defenses are largely derived from image classification, while dedicated segmentation defenses remain scarce and typically require retraining or model modification. We introduce RePAIR, a post-hoc, label-free, attack-unaware defense based on the observation that backdoor-induced shifts can be stronger in the classifier head than in internal representations, leaving recoverable victim-class semantics. RePAIR infers the victim-target relation from an unlabeled, potentially contaminated image pool, constructs a safety-approved semantic reference, and localizes suspicious pixels by comparing head predictions with internal semantic evidence. It then applies feature-space and output corrections toward the inferred victim semantics, while conservative localization and output constraints limit changes to benign predictions. We model the attack as adversarial probability transport and repair as its approximate reversal, deriving bounds and sufficient conditions for localization, residual attack success, clean-side changes, defense-induced target predictions, and attack-unaware pair identification. Experiments across segmentation architectures and attack settings show that RePAIR substantially reduces attack success while largely preserving clean performance.
blocks.zh: 尽管在计算机视觉方面取得了重大进展,语义分解模型仍然容易受到后门攻击,造成了安全风险. 这些攻击将选择的受害者类的像素在触发器出现时重定向到攻击者指定的目标类,同时保留了干净的预测. 现有的防御主要出自于图像分类,而专用分解防御仍然很少,通常需要再培训或模型修改. 我们引入了RePAIR,一种后热,无标签,攻击-unaware的防守,基于以下观察,即后门引发的转向在分类头部比内部代表部更强,留下了可恢复的受害者类语义. REPAIR推断出未加标签、可能受污染的图像池中的受害人-目标关系,构建了安全核准的语义参考,通过将头部预测与内部语义证据进行比较,将可疑像素本地化。 然后,它将特征空间和输出校正适用于被推断出的受害者语义,而保守的局部化和输出限制限制了良性预测的变化. 我们把攻击作为敌方概率的迁移和修复作为大概的倒转, 得出局部化的界限和足够条件, 残余的攻击成功, 干净的侧面变化, 防御引起的目标预测, 以及攻击-无意识的对称识别。 跨分解架构和攻击设置的实验显示,RePAIR在基本保持清洁性能的同时会大幅降低攻击成功.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Semantic segmentation assigns a semantic class to every pixel proving perception in safety-critical systems such as automated driving ( Cakir et al., 2022 ) and medical imaging ( Taghanaki et al., 2024 ) .
Semantic segmentation networks are vulnerable to backdoor attacks that preserve normal performance on benign inputs while inducing targeted failures when a trigger is present ( Li et al., 2021b ) .
For instance, a backdoor can cause a vehicle to disappear from the semantic map by relabeling its pixels as road, without affecting the prediction for the rest of the image.
Semantic segmentation backdoors have developed from fixed trigger patterns and predefined victim–target mappings ( Li et al., 2021b ) toward increasingly flexible attack settings. Existing attacks allow the victim class to depend on trigger placement ( Mao et al., 2023 ) , exploit contextual relationships between semantic classes ( Abbasi et al., 2025 ) , or automatically optimize triggers and attack configurations ( Lan et al., 2024 ) .
These attacks demonstrate that backdoors can induce targeted and spatially localized prediction changes under
flexible conditions, making the development of robust defenses challenging.
blocks.zh:
语义分解为在自动驾驶(Cakir等人,2022年)和医学成像(Taghanaki等人,2024年)等安全关键系统中证明感知的每个像素都指定了一个语义类.
语义分解网络容易受到后门攻击,这种攻击在良性投入上保持正常性能,同时在触发物存在时诱发定向故障(Li等人,2021b ).
例如,后门通过将其像素重新贴上道路标签,而不影响对图像其余部分的预测,可以导致车辆从语义图上消失.
语义分裂的后门已经从固定的触发模式和预先定义的受害者-目标绘图(Li等人,2021年b)发展到越来越灵活的攻击环境。 现有攻击使得受害者阶层依赖于触发位置(Mao等人,2023年),利用语义类之间的背景关系(Abbasi等人,2025年),或自动优化触发和攻击配置(Lan等人,2024年).
这些攻击表明,后门可诱发目标明确和空间局部的预测变化。
灵活的条件,使得强力防御的发展具有挑战性.

blocks.en:
While attacks on dense prediction tasks have received increasing attention, effective defenses remain comparatively underexplored.
Detection-oriented methods can identify suspicious inputs or models but do not necessarily remove the underlying backdoor ( Liu et al., 2023 ) .
Mitigation approaches based on retraining (e.g. fine-tuning and pruning) often require additional clean data and may alter the model’s behavior ( Liu et al., 2018 ) .
For semantic segmentation, effective defenses should selectively correct attacked pixels while limiting changes to unrelated regions, motivating selective repair rather than global model modification.
blocks.zh:
虽然对密集预测任务的攻击受到越来越多的关注,但有效的防御仍然相对未得到充分的探索.
以侦测为导向的方法可以识别可疑的投入或模型,但不一定去掉背后的后门(Liu等人,2023年)。
基于再培训的缓解方法(如微调和修饰)往往需要额外的清洁数据,并可能改变模型的行为(Liu等人,2018年)。
对于语义分割,有效的防御应该有选择地纠正被攻击的像素,同时将变化限制在无关的区域,激发选择性修复而不是全球模型修改.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce a Re presentation-guided pixel-wise attack Re pair (RePAIR) against backdoor attacks on semantic segmentation models.
We focus on a key empirical observation: the backdoor-induced shift can be substantially stronger in the final task decision than in an appropriately chosen internal semantic representation, even when the encoder itself is affected by the backdoor.
Victim semantics can therefore remain partially recoverable even when
the head predicts the attacker-selected target. The representation that exposes this
state is architecture-dependent.
E.g. for DeepLabV3+ ( Chen et al., 2018 ) with a ResNet-50 backbone, the final backbone stage immediately before atrous spatial pyramid pooling provides a useful reference.
For SegFormer ( Xie et al., 2021 ) with a MiT-B5 backbone, no single block is sufficient.
Victim evidence is distributed across several internal blocks and is reconstructed by a learned
multi-layer logistic read-out.

blocks.en:
This observation has a natural geometric interpretation.
For each pixel, the predicted class probabilities form a point in the probability simplex, where each coordinate represents the probability assigned to one semantic class.
An idealized targeted backdoor shifts probability mass from a victim class to an attacker-selected target class, moving the prediction toward the target and away from the victim while remaining within the same simplex.
Natural segmentation errors can also shift probability mass between classes (typically not concentrated in one direction), but a backdoor induces a systematic flow from one semantic class to another.
blocks.zh:
此观察有自然几何解释.
对于每个像素,预测的类概率在概率简单的x中形成一个点,其中每个坐标代表分配给一个语义类的概率.
一个理想化的目标后门将概率质量从受害者类别转移到攻击者选定的目标类别,将预测移向目标,并远离受害者,同时保持在同一简形之内。
自然分解错误也可以在类间转移概率质量(一般不集中在一个方向),但后门会诱导从一个语义类到另一个语义类的系统流.

blocks.en:
This directed view can be described by a local transport operator acting on the class-probability distribution.
RePAIR approximates the corresponding reverse transport from surviving victim evidence and model-derived reference geometry, while treating feasible victim-target pairs as hypotheses and identifying the attacked relation without prior knowledge of either class.
blocks.zh:
这种定向观点可由当地运输运营商在等级概率分布上进行描述.
RePAIR从幸存的受害人证据和模型衍生的参考几何学中大致得出相应的逆向迁移,同时将可行的受害人-目标对作为假设,并在事先不知道任一类别的情况下确定受攻击的关系。

blocks.en:
A correct victim–target pair alone is not sufficient for a safe repair.
The reference data used for repair must also be protected from poisoned samples, otherwise, the defense may learn the very distortion it is meant to remove.
We therefore first identify candidate clean images and then check whether they provide reliable evidence of the victim class before using them for repair.
An image is rejected if its internal victim evidence is severely degraded, or if a moderate degradation is accompanied by an unusually strong shift from the victim class to the target class.
Rejected images are not replaced merely to meet a desired reference-set size.
If too little reliable victim evidence remains, the defense does not construct a repair state.
Together, these components form our method for selective and reliable backdoor repair.
The source code of our method is publicly available at https://github.com/A-Brosch/RePAIR .
Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We introduce a post-hoc repair method for backdoored semantic segmentation models that reconstructs victim-consistent semantics and selectively corrects attacked pixels, without retraining or globally modifying the deployed network. • We develop a theoretical framework that models targeted segmentation backdoors as directed victim-to-target transport in the class-probability simplex. This view links surviving internal evidence to localization, residual attack success, attack-unaware pair identification, and clean-side safety. • Our method for generating a reliable repair reference is attack-unaware and operates on potentially compromised data. It identifies consistent victim-to-target evidence and screens candidate clean-like images with a one-way victim-safety firewall. • We develop architecture-specific semantic references for both convolutional- and transformer-based segmentation models, showing that the information required for repair may be concentrated in a single representation or distributed across multiple internal layers.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The first work adapted the BadNets attack ( Gu et al., 2019 ) from image classification to semantic segmentation, using either a black stripe at the image border as a non-semantic trigger or a semantic class present in the image as a trigger ( Li et al., 2021b ) . Once activated, the attack relabeled all pixels of a victim class as a target class.
The Influencer Backdoor Attack (IBA, ( Lan et al., 2024 ) ) places a trigger on non-victim pixels while relabeling the victim class as a predefined target.
It further introduces Nearest Neighbor Injection (NNI) and Pixel Random Labeling (PRL), which respectively place the trigger near the victim region and add random label changes to non-victim pixels to strengthen the attack’s reliance on global context.
The Object-Free Backdoor Attack (OFBA, ( Mao et al., 2023 ) ) places the trigger on the target object and varies victim classes and trigger positions during training, allowing the victim class to be selected by trigger placement at inference time while keeping the target class fixed.
The Contextual Segmentation attack (ConSeg) uses a natural semantic trigger, such as a motorcycle, instead of an artificial pattern ( Abbasi et al., 2025 ) . It relabels the victim class as the target and adds a small number of co-occurring target-related classes within the victim region to strengthen the contextual association.
BADSEG ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) broadens the attack space to four attack types: Object-to-Object (O2O), Object-to-Background (O2B), Background-to-Object (B2O), and Background-to-Background (B2B), along with instance-level and conditional variants.
A surrogate model optimizes trigger parameters and selects victim-target pairs using feature-space class centroids.

影响者后门攻击(IBA,(Lan等人,2024年))在将受害者阶层重新贴上预定目标标签的同时,对非受害者像素设置了扳机.
它进一步引入了NNI和Pixel Random Labeling(PRL),它们分别将触发器置于受害者区域附近,并在非受害者像素中加入随机的标签更改,以加强攻击对全局背景的依赖.

blocks.en:
Defense Methods. Work on defenses against backdoor attacks in semantic segmentation remains limited, and existing studies therefore mainly adapt defenses originally developed for image classification.
Test-time detection methods such as STRIP ( Gao et al., 2019 ) and TeCo ( Liu et al., 2023 ) detect suspicious inputs by measuring prediction entropy under image superposition or prediction consistency under image corruptions, respectively.
Similarly, Zeng et al. ( Zeng et al., 2021 ) detect anomalous trigger-related patterns in frequency domain ( Ahmed et al., 1974 ) .
BEATRIX ( Ma et al., 2023 ) detects anomalous internal representations using class-conditional higher-order Gram matrices ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
These methods aim to identify suspicious inputs but do not repair the affected predictions or remove the underlying backdoor.
Pruning ( Liu et al., 2018 ) removes neurons with low activation on benign inputs and fine-tunes the remaining network on clean data to eliminate dormant backdoor components and recover clean performance.
Fine-tuning ( Sha et al., 2022 ) instead directly retrains the potentially compromised model on clean data to weaken the learned association between trigger and target.
Both methods were also evaluated as defenses against segmentation backdoors, but both require access to clean data for mitigation ( Lan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Segment Cleanse ( Mao et al., 2023 ) adapts Neural Cleanse ( Wang et al., 2019 ) to semantic segmentation by reconstructing object-level trigger candidates and
mitigating detected backdoors through retraining, likewise requiring model modification and clean data.
Anti Backdoor Learning (ABL, ( Li et al., 2021a ) ) exploits differences in training loss dynamics to identify suspicious samples and reduce their influence through gradient ascent.
While these approaches identify or suppress backdoor behavior, they do not enable post-hoc, selective repair of affected pixels in a deployed model.

STRIP(Gao等人,2019年)和TeCo(Liu等人,2023年)等测试时间检测方法通过在图像叠加下分别测量预测 en或图像腐败下预测一致性来检测可疑输入.
与此类似,曾等. (Zeng等人,2021年) 探测频率域中的异常触发模式(Ahmed等人,1974年).
BEATRIX(马等人,2023年)利用阶级条件较高的格律矩阵检测到异常的内部表示(张等人,2026年).
这些方法旨在查明可疑的投入,但不修复受影响的预测,也不去除背后的后门。
Pruning(Liu 等人,2018年)移除了在良性输入上激活率低的神经元,并对剩余清洁数据的网络进行了微调,以消除休眠的后门组件,恢复清洁性能.
微调(Sha等人,2022年)转而直接重述在清洁数据上可能受损的模型,以削弱触发器与目标之间的学习联系。
这两种方法也被评价为防御分化后门,但都需要获得清洁数据以进行缓解(Lan等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年)。

通过再培训减轻检测到的后门,同样需要模型修改和清洁数据。
反后门学习(ABL,(Li等人,2021a))利用训练损失动态的差异来识别可疑样本,并通过梯度上升来减少其影响.
虽然这些方法能够识别或抑制后门行为,但它们无法在部署的模型中选择性地修复受影响的像素。

blocks.en:
RePAIR differs from detection-based methods (e.g. STRIP, TeCo, frequency-domain defenses, and BEATRIX), which identify suspicious inputs, samples, or internal representations but do not repair the affected predictions.
In contrast to model-modification approaches such as pruning, fine-tuning, and Segment Cleanse, our method does not retrain or otherwise alter the compromised model.
It is also applied post-hoc, unlike ABL, which operates during training.
Finally, RePAIR requires neither ground truth labels nor an external clean reference set, instead deriving the information needed for selective repair from the model and available data while leaving unaffected predictions unchanged.

RePAIR不同于基于探测的方法(如STRIP,TeCo,频域防御,和BEATRIX),这些方法识别出可疑的投入,样品,或内部表示,但并不修复受影响的预测.
与模型修饰方法,如修饰、微调和分层清洁方法不同,我们的方法不会重新训练或以其他方式改变受损的模型。
与ABL不同,后者在培训期间运作。
最后,RePAIR既不需要地面真象标签,也不需要外部干净的参考集,而是从模型和现有数据中获取有选择的修复所需的信息,同时使未受影响的预测保持不变。

blocks.en: 3 Theoretical Framework
blocks.zh: 3 理论框架

blocks.en:
We view a targeted backdoor in semantic segmentation as a trigger-induced, spatially selective change in dense predictions.
Semantic segmentation predicts a probability distribution over semantic classes for each pixel, allowing a backdoor to selectively alter the predictions of pixels belonging to a particular victim class.
During training, the attacker introduces triggered images with modified pixel-wise labels, assigning victim-class pixels to an attacker-selected target class.
When activated, the backdoor causes pixels belonging to a victim class to be relabeled as an attacker-selected target class, while leaving other pixels largely unaffected.
We treat the images as samples of a stochastic process, we further assume the neural network to learn the induced distribution during training.
In order to change the argmax of the attacked pixels’ prediction the trigger has to lead to redistribution of probabilisitc mass from one atom to another (assumed to be mostly from victim to target class).
The possibility of recognizing and “inverting” this transport yields two effects, the identification of victim and target class and nullyfication of the triggers effect, thus rendering it use- and harmless.
blocks.zh:
我们认为,语义分裂中的目标后门是一种触发、空间选择性的密集预测变化。

blocks.en:
RePAIR is a post-hoc, label-free, attack-unaware defense for targeted semantic segmentation backdoors.
The compromised model remains frozen. The defense uses
neither trigger reconstruction nor retraining, and uses no semantic ground truth, clean/poison provenance, attack mask, attack family, poisoning rate, or predefined victim-target pair.
Its inputs are the model and an
unlabeled image pool that may contain triggered samples.
The method has two stages.
First, an offline builder identifies a directed victim-target relation from model-derived evidence and constructs a conservative, safety-approved reference state.
Throughout this section, ( v , t ) (v,t) denotes the operational victim–target pair
released by the attack-unaware builder.
At inference, a pair-conditioned localizer identifies inconsistent pixels, feature transport moves them toward victim semantics, and output safety limits unintended changes.
More details are provided in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en:
Attack-unaware pair discovery. Every feasible ordered pair ( v , t ) (v,t) is initially treated as a candidate victim-target relation.
For CNNs, the primary signal is internal-to-head contradiction: evidence for ( v , t ) (v,t) increases when pixels retain victim-class evidence in the internal representation while the segmentation head predicts t t .
This evidence is aggregated over frozen, image-disjoint reference views and retained only when the support is sufficiently stable and separated from competing pairs.
The resulting pair defines the victim-to-target direction used by the subsequent localization and repair stages.
Thus, RePAIR can identify the attack direction directly from model-derived evidence, without requiring prior knowledge of the victim or target class.
blocks.zh:
攻击-无意识双人发现. 每一个可行的配对(v, t) (v, t) 最初被作为候选的受害者-目标关系对待.
对CNN来说,主要信号是内部对头的矛盾:当像素在内部代表中保留受害者类证据时,(v, t) (v, t)的证据会增加,而分头则预测 t.
这些证据经过冷冻、图像分离的参考视图加以汇总,只有在支持足够稳定并与竞争对等分开时才予以保留。
由此产生的配对定义了随后的本地化和维修阶段所使用的受害者与目标的方向。
因此,RePAIR可以直接从模型生成的证据中识别攻击方向,而不需要事先了解受害者或目标类别.

blocks.en:
For transformers, candidate structure is first identified using lightweight head, transfer, centroid, and structural cues. Supported pairs are then evaluated using image-disjoint joint-LogReg out-of-fold (OOF) evidence, with a separate OOF state for each pair.
Stable family proposals are formed from structural, mechanism, and family-verification evidence. The frozen rank prior is retained whenever it passes the candidate viability test.
If the prior family is not viable, another family may be selected only through the conservative rescue path, which requires bilateral leave-one-out support and bilateral structural consistency.
blocks.zh:
对变压器来说,候选结构首先使用轻量级头部,转动,中心机器人,以及结构提示来识别. 支持的对子然后使用图像-断联联合-LogReg的外倍数(OOF)证据进行评价,每对子都有单独的OOF状态.
根据结构、机制和家庭核查证据,形成了稳定的家庭建议。 在通过候选人生存能力测试时,保留被冻结的前级。
如果先前的家族不可行,则只能通过保守的营救路径选择另一个家族,这需要双边的一离不开支持和双边的结构一致性.

blocks.en:
After the family has been frozen, its two possible victim-target directions are evaluated using FullEdge, FamilyVerify, and eligible Mechanism evidence.
A direction is accepted only when the required direction agreement is unique.
Structural evidence is not a regular direction vote and is used only to corroborate the rescue rule when the Mechanism direction channel is ineligible.
If family viability or direction evidence is insufficient, the mapping remains inactive. The exact release contract is given in Appendix A.1.6 .
blocks.zh:
在家庭被冻结后,利用FullEdge、FamilyVerify和合格的机制证据评估其两个可能的受害人目标指示。
只有当要求的方向协议是独一无二的时才接受指示。
结构证据不是常规方向投票,只有在机制方向渠道不合格时才用于证实救援规则。
如果家庭生存能力或方向证据不足,则制图工作仍不活跃。 确切的释放合同见附录A.1.6。

blocks.en:
Safety-approved reference state. After a victim-target pair has been selected, a correct mapping is not yet sufficient because the unlabeled image pool may itself contain poisoned samples.
The builder therefore screens candidate reference images using image-disjoint cross-fitting and a victim-safety firewall.
Images with unstable internal predictions are first rejected, followed by a safety filter that removes images showing severe victim-class collapse or moderate victim degradation accompanied by an unusually strong victim-to-target contradiction.
These filters are applied sequentially and monotonically: rejected images are not reintroduced to satisfy a desired reference-set size, and thresholds are not relaxed to rescue an insufficient population.
blocks.zh:
安全核准参考状态。 在选定了受害者-目标对之后,正确的映射还是不够的,因为未贴标签的图像池本身可能含有有毒样品。
因此,建造者利用图像不匹配的交叉配置和受害人安全防火墙筛选候选参考图像。
内部预测不稳定的图像首先被拒绝,然后是安全过滤器,删除显示严重受害者级崩溃或适度受害者退化的图像,同时出现异常强烈的受害者与目标矛盾。
这些滤镜按顺序和单调进行:拒绝的图像不会被重新用于满足理想的参考设置大小,阈值也不会被放松以拯救不足的人口.

blocks.en:
The builder then checks whether the remaining images provide sufficient reliable support and semantic coverage for the selected victim-target pair.
If not, the repair state remains inactive and no repair is applied at inference time.
Otherwise, all runtime components, including semantic references, probability statistics, feature-space reference banks, and repair calibrations, are constructed exclusively from the final safety-approved population.
We use this term rather than clean reference set because the defense has no access to the true provenance of the images and therefore cannot guarantee that they are trigger-free.
blocks.zh:
制作者然后检查其余图像是否为选定的受害人-目标对提供了充分的可靠支持和语义覆盖。
如果没有,则修理状态不活动,在推断时间不进行修理。
否则,所有运行时间组件,包括语义参考、概率统计、地物空间参考库以及修理校准,都是完全从最后的安全核准人群中建造的。
我们使用这个术语而不是干净的参考设定,因为辩护方无法获取图像的真实来源,因此无法保证图像是无触发的.

blocks.en:
The resulting state provides the empirical victim-side reference used by the runtime defense.
It is not treated as the unknown clean distribution p ⋆ p^{\star} and is not assumed to be uncontaminated, i.e., it is instead a model-derived reference population that has passed the defense’s one-way safety checks.
blocks.zh:
由此产生的状态提供了运行时间辩护所使用的经验性受害者方参考.
它不被视为未知的清洁分布p ⋆ p^{\star}, 也不被假定为未受污染,

blocks.en:
Pair-consistent localization. Localization combines direct semantic contradiction with residual tests for pixels whose internal victim evidence is weak or distributed across multiple features.
A shared probability branch compares the observed target-over-victim probability excess d p ​ ( x ) = q t ​ ( x ) − q v ​ ( x ) d_{p}(x)=q_{t}(x)-q_{v}(x) with a semantically matched reference excess.
Victim and target reference neighborhoods provide matched reference values and a semantic interpolation coordinate, yielding the expected excess d ^ ref ​ ( x ) \widehat{d}_{\mathrm{ref}}(x) .
RePAIR measures the one-sided residual D prob ​ ( x ) = [ d p ​ ( x ) − d ^ ref ​ ( x ) ] + D_{\mathrm{prob}}(x)=[d_{p}(x)-\widehat{d}_{\mathrm{ref}}(x)]_{+} , which is calibrated image-disjointly on the frozen safety-approved population using an empirical reference-pixel budget.
This budget controls the probability-residual calibration and is distinct from the repair margin.
Matching is performed after removing the victim-target semantic axis, so the expected margin is conditioned on the remaining semantic geometry rather than on the displacement being tested.

blocks.en:
CNNs combine the preserved semantic contradiction with target-manifold, self-counterfactual, and probability-residual cues.
Transformer use five sequential, mutually exclusive stages restricted to baseline head-target pixels: semantic contradiction, residual victim-manifold rupture, residual
target-manifold rupture, residual counterfactual manifold trajectory, and residual semantic probability.
Their union defines M TF M_{\mathrm{TF}} and satisfies M TF ⊆ { Y ^ head = t } M_{\mathrm{TF}}\subseteq\{\widehat{Y}^{\mathrm{head}}=t\} .
The staged construction records why a pixel was selected, prevents later branches from relabeling an earlier decision,
and enables branch-specific repair.
Exact masks and image-disjoint calibration rules are given in Appendix A.2.4 .

并且能够进行具体分支的修复。
准确的口罩和图像分离校准规则见附录A.2.4。

blocks.en:
Feature-first repair. RePAIR first repairs the internal representation of localized pixels before applying any residual output correction.
For each localized feature, the discovered victim-target direction is removed from the retrieval geometry, and safety-approved victim references are searched in the orthogonal complement.
The retrieved neighborhood is aggregated and the feature is transported toward the victim reference with branch-dependent strength, while preserving its original norm.
The modified representation is then passed through the unchanged remainder of the network.
By matching in the orthogonal complement, the reference search is not dominated by the same victim-target displacement that the repair is intended to reverse.
blocks.zh:
特色第一修复. RePAIR在应用任何剩余输出校正之前,首先修复本地像素的内部代表.
对每个局部特征,从检索几何中去掉发现的受害人-目标方向,并在正体补充中搜索安全核准的受害人参考文献。
被回收的街区被汇总起来,其特征以依赖分支的力量被传送到受害者的参考文献,同时保持其原始规范.
然后,经过修改的表述通过网络的其余部分。
通过在正向补充中匹配,参考搜索并不以修复旨在逆转的同一受害者-目标迁移为主.

blocks.en:
If the feature repair does not fully restore the victim prediction, RePAIR applies a conservative output correction restricted to the discovered victim-target pair.
The correction is calibrated from safety-approved victim references and can be partial depending on the repair branch.
Thus, feature transport and output correction address the same victim-target discrepancy at different stages: feature transport moves the internal representation toward victim semantics, while the output step corrects residual target predictions by directly modifying only the victim and target
logits.
blocks.zh:
如果特征修复不能完全恢复受害者的预测,REPAIR采用保守的输出校正,仅限于发现的受害者-目标对.
校正内容从安全核准的受害人参考材料中校准,可视维修分支部分校正.
因此,特性迁移和产出修正在不同阶段解决了同样的受害者-目标差异:特性迁移将内部代表转向受害者的语义学,而产出步骤则通过直接修改受害者和目标来纠正剩余目标预测。

The resulting feature transport approximates the reverse-transport direction without requiring the unknown clean distribution or transport magnitude.
The discovered pair provides the direction, while the safety-approved victim references provide the local repair target.

由此产生的运输特征大致相当于逆向运输,而不需要未知的清洁分布或运输量。
发现的配对提供了方向,而安全核准的受害人参考文献提供了当地的修复目标.

blocks.en:
Output safety and decision isolation. Let Y ^ rep \widehat{Y}^{\mathrm{rep}} denote the prediction after repair but before output safety.
The No New Target Veto restores Y ^ head \widehat{Y}^{\mathrm{head}} whenever the repair changes a pixel outside the authorized mask to the discovered target class t t , provided that the original head prediction was not t t .
Thus, the veto prevents unsupported new target predictions outside the repair support while leaving existing target predictions unaffected.
The veto is intentionally asymmetric and only constrains the creation of the discovered target.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate RePAIR on Cityscapes ( Cordts et al., 2016 ) , PASCAL VOC 2012 ( Everingham et al., 2015 ) and ADE20K ( et al., 2017 ) .
We consider two representative segmentation architectures, DeepLabV3+ with a
ResNet-50 backbone ( Chen et al., 2018 ) and SegFormer with a MiT-B5
backbone ( Xie et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们评价了城市景观上的REPAIR(Cordts等人,2016年),PASCAL VOC 2012(Everingham等人,2015年)和ADE20K(等人,2017年).
我们认为,有两个具有代表性的分块结构,即DeepLabV3+和一个
ResNet-50主干线 (Chen等人,2018年)和带有MiT-B5的SegFormer
骨干(谢等人,2021年).

blocks.en:
We evaluate backdoor attacks at a 10 % 10\% poison rate, including IBA with NNI and PRL strategies, ConSeg, OFBA, and BadSeg with all four attack configurations.
For all object-to-background attacks (IBA NNI, IBA PRL, ConSeg, OFBA, and BadSeg-O2B), we use car → \rightarrow road as the victim-target pair.
For the remaining attack configurations, we use car → \rightarrow person for object-to-object, sidewalk → \rightarrow road for background-to-background, and road → \rightarrow car for background-to-object attacks.
blocks.zh:
我们以10%的毒性率评估后门攻击, 包括有NNI和PRL策略的IBA、Conseg、OFBA和BadSeg,
对所有物体对背攻击(IBA NNI,IBA PRL,康塞格,OFBA,以及BadSeg-O2B),我们使用汽车~\右路作为受害者-目标对.
对于其余的攻击配置,我们使用车 \ 右手人对物体,人行道 \ 右手人对背景, 道路\ 右手人对背景攻击。

blocks.en:
We compare RePAIR against all defense methods, i.e., pruning, fine-tuning, Segment Cleanse, and ABL.
Performance is evaluated using Attack Success Rate (ASR), benign mean intersection-over-union (mIOU-B), and attacked mIoU (mIOU-A).
For BadSeg-B2O, ASR is restricted to ground-truth victim pixels inside the designated attack region.
More details on metric definitions and experimental configurations are provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们比较RePAIR 与所有防御方法,即:钻探、微调、分层清理和ABL。
使用攻击成功率(ASR),良性平均交叉结合(mIOU-B),以及攻击mIOU(mIOU-A),来评价性能.
对于BadSeg-B2O,ASR仅限于指定攻击区内的地面真实受害者像素.
附录A.3提供了有关计量定义和实验配置的更多细节。

blocks.en: 5.2 Numerical Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 数值结果

blocks.en:
Attack success rate. Table 1 reports attack success rate before and after applying the evaluated defenses for the Cityscapes dataset.
Lower values indicate stronger attack mitigation. ASR measures the fraction of victim-class pixels that are misclassified as the attacker-selected target class on triggered inputs.
blocks.zh:
攻击成功率。 表1报告攻击了在Cityscapes数据集应用评估的防御手段前后的成功率。
数值较低表明减轻攻击的能力更强。 ASR测量在触发输入上被误归类为攻击者选择的目标类的受害者级像素的一小部分.

blocks.en:
For DeepLabV3+, the undefended model achieves high ASR across all attacks, ranging from 60.83 % 60.83\% to 97.41 % 97.41\% .
Fine-tuning and pruning provide little mitigation and leave the ASR high for most attacks.
In contrast, RePAIR consistently reduces the ASR to below 7.86 % 7.86\% across all evaluated attacks.
This consistent performance across different attack types is not observed for the other defense methods.
Segment Cleanse achieves effective mitigation for IBA and OFBA, but performs substantially worse on the BadSeg attacks compared to our defense.
Overall, RePAIR achieves the best or second-best ASR for most attacks and maintains strong mitigation consistently across the full attack set.
blocks.zh:
对于DeepLabV3+,无防守模式在所有攻击中实现高ASR,从60.83% 60.83\%到97.41% 97.41\%不等.
微调和刷新使缓解效果微乎其微,使ASR在大多数攻击中保持高水平.
反之,REPAIR在所有评估的攻击中始终将ASR降低到7.86%7.86%以下.
其他防御方法没有观察到不同攻击类型之间这种一致的表现。
Cleanse为IBA和OFBA实现了有效缓解,但在BadSeg袭击方面却比我们的防守要糟糕得多。
总体而言,RePAIR在大多数攻击中取得了最佳或二佳的ASR,并在整个攻击中始终保持强有力的缓解。

blocks.en:
For SegFormer, the undefended model shows lower ASR for several attacks, with values ranging from 26.43 % 26.43\% to 95.46 % 95.46\% .
Fine-tuning and pruning again provide limited mitigation, while Segment Cleanse also fails to consistently reduce the ASR.
ABL provides more consistent mitigation across the evaluated attacks.
RePAIR achieves lower ASR than all other evaluated defenses on all backdoor attacks, reducing the ASR to below 0.54 % 0.54\% and frequently to zero.
Thus, for these cases, our defense prevents the attack from successfully redirecting any victim-class pixels to the target class.
blocks.zh:
对于 SegFormer,未防守的模型显示一些攻击的ASR较低,其值从26.43% 26.43%到95.46% 95.46%不等.
精细调整和冲刷再次提供了有限的缓解,而部分清洁也未能始终减少ASR。
ABL在评估的攻击中提供更一致的缓解。
RePAIR在所有后门攻击中实现的ASR低于所有其他评估的防御,将ASR降低到0.54%0.54\%以下,并经常降至零.
因此,对于这些案例,我们的防御 阻止攻击 成功将任何受害者级像素 转向目标级。

blocks.en:
Segmentation performance. Table 1 reports the mean mIoU-B and mIoU-A across all evaluated attacks in the two rightmost columns.
The clean models, without a backdoor attack or defense, achieve an mIoU-B of 78.74 % 78.74\% for DeepLabV3+ and 80.46 % 80.46\% for SegFormer, representing the upper reference for benign segmentation performance.
Under attack, the goal is to preserve this performance on benign classes while recovering the attacked classes.
blocks.zh:
分化表现. 表1报告,在最右两栏的所有评估攻击中,平均MIOU-B和MIU-A。
干净的模型,没有后门攻击或防御,实现了深LabV3+78.74%的mIoU-B和SegFormer80.46%的80.46%的mIoU-B,是良性分化性能的上位参考.
受攻击,目标是在恢复受攻击的班级的同时,将这种表现保留在良性班级.

blocks.en:
The undefended backdoored models retain an mIoU-B of 73.28 % 73.28\% for DeepLabV3+ and 75.80 % 75.80\% for SegFormer, showing that the attacks primarily affect the targeted classes.
In contrast, ABL substantially degrades mIoU-B, indicating that its mitigation affects benign predictions beyond the attacked classes.
RePAIR maintains mIoU-B at 74.50 % 74.50\% for DeepLabV3+ and 72.30 % 72.30\% for SegFormer, while achieving the highest mIoU-A among the evaluated defenses.
Thus, RePAIR combines recovery of the attacked classes with preservation of the model’s general segmentation performance.
blocks.zh:
无防守的后门模型保留了深LabV3+73.28%的mIoU-B和SegFormer75.80%的75.80%的mIoU-B,表明攻击主要影响目标阶层.
相比之下,ABL则大幅降解mIoU-B,表明其缓解影响良性预测,超出受攻击类别.
RePAIR将mIoU-B维持在74.50%74.50%%的DeepLabV3+和72.30%的segFormer,同时在评估的防御中实现了最高的mIoU-A.
因此,RePAIR将恢复受攻击的阶层与保持模型的普通分区性能结合起来。

blocks.en: Table 1: Cityscapes results across backdoor attacks. ASR is the primary metric, with lower values indicating better defense performance. mIoU-A and mIoU-B are averaged across the eight attacks and reported with their minimum and maximum deviations from the mean.
blocks.zh: 表1 城市景观对后门的攻击。 ASR是主要的衡量标准,较低的数值表明防御性能更好. mIoU-A和mIOU-B在8次攻击中平均都呈报,并报告其与平均值的最小和最大偏差.

blocks.en:
Other datasets. We additionally evaluate RePAIR on PASCAL VOC 2012 and ADE20K, considering only Object-to-Background attack configurations for both datasets.
On ADE20K, the evaluated attack configurations do not produce a sufficiently strong backdoor effect in the undefended models to support a meaningful mitigation study. This behavior is further analyzed theoretically in Appendix A.1 , and the corresponding results are reported in Table 5 .

blocks.en:
PASCAL VOC differs from Cityscapes primarily in the number of semantic classes present within each image. Images in PASCAL VOC typically contain a single foreground object class together with a background label that aggregates all other classes. This different class composition affects the learned class representations and, consequently, the information available to the defense.
Across the evaluated attacks, the undefended models achieve ASR ranging from 12.21 % 12.21\% for NNI to 99.71 % 99.71\% for ConSeg, while RePAIR reduces the remaining ASR to between 5.41 % 5.41\% and 19.67 % 19.67\% . The corresponding results are reported in Table 6 and 7 .

在所评估的攻击中,无防守模式的ASR从NNI的12.21%到康塞格的99.71%到99.71%,而REPAIR则将剩余的ASR减少到5.41%5.41 %到19.67% 19.67%。 相应结果见表6和表7。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced RePAIR, a post-hoc, label-free, and attack-unaware defense that exploits surviving internal victim-class evidence to localize and selectively repair backdoor-affected pixels without retraining the compromised segmentation model.
Across eight attack configurations on Cityscapes, RePAIR reduces the defended ASR to 0.46 % 0.46\% - 7.86 % 7.86\% for DeepLabV3+ and to at most 0.54 % 0.54\% for SegFormer, with complete suppression of the measured attack success in six of the eight SegFormer settings.
At the same time, RePAIR preserves substantial segmentation utility, achieving an average mIoU-B of 74.50 % 74.50\% for DeepLabV3+ and 72.30 % 72.30\% for SegFormer, compared with 73.28 % 73.28\% and 75.80 % 75.80\% for the corresponding undefended models.

在Cityscapes的8个攻击配置中,REPAIR将防御的ASR降低到0.46% 0.46% - 7.86% 深LabV3+的7.86%,将SegFormer降低到最多0.54%,在8个SegFormer设置中,完全压制了6个测得的攻击成功.
同时,RePAIR保留了大量的分解功能,DeepLabV3+的mIoU-B平均为74.50% 74.50%,segFormer为72.30% 72.30%,相比之下,73.28% 73.28%和75.80%对应的不设防模型为75.80%.

blocks.en:
Beyond the overall mitigation performance, the experiments show that effective backdoor repair can be achieved without explicitly reconstructing the trigger or modifying the compromised model.
The directed-transport formulation provides a view of the attack as a structured victim-to-target shift, while the internal representation provides a model-derived reference for reversing this shift selectively.
Across convolutional and transformer-based architectures, these results indicate that surviving internal semantic evidence can serve as a basis for attack-unaware localization and constrained pixel-wise repair.

定向运输的表述将攻击视为有条理的受害人与目标之间的转移,而内部表述则为有选择地扭转这种转移提供了一种模式参考。
这些结果表明,在整体上,以转录和变压器为基础的结构中,幸存的内部语义证据可以作为攻击-unaware本地化和受限像素-wisel修复的基础。

blocks.en: A.3 Details on experimental setting
blocks.zh: A.3 试验设置的细节

blocks.en:
We consider three datasets for evaluation, namely Cityscapes Cordts et al. (2016) , ADE20K ( et al., 2017 ) , and PASCAL VOC 2012 ( Everingham et al., 2015 ) .
Cityscapes consists of 2,975 2,\!975 training and 500 500 validation images with a fixed resolution of 2048 × 1024 2048\times 1024 pixels and defines 19 19 semantic classes for evaluation.
The dataset focuses on densely annotated urban street scenes and contains a diverse set of simultaneously occurring object and stuff classes, such as roads, buildings, vegetation, pedestrians, and vehicles.
blocks.zh:
我们考虑了三个评价数据集,即Cityscapes Cordts等人(2016年)、ADE20K(等人,2017年)和PASCAL VOC 2012(Everingham等人,2015年)。
城市景观包含2,975,\2!975培训及500个验证图像,固定分辨率为2048×1024 2048\times 1024像素,并定义了19个语义类课程进行评价.
数据集侧重于注解密集的城市街道场景,并包含各种同时发生的物品类,如道路,建筑,植被,行人,车辆等.

blocks.en: ADE20K is a substantially larger and more scene-centric benchmark, comprising 20,210 20,\!210 training and 2,000 2,\!000 validation images with variable native resolutions and dense pixel-level annotations across 150 150 semantic classes, including both object and stuff categories.
blocks.zh: ADE20K是一个大得多,更以场景为中心的基准,包括20,210 20,\!210训练以及2000,2\!000验证图像,具有可变的原生分辨率和密集的像素级说明,覆盖150个150个语义类,包括对象类和物类.

blocks.en:
We further evaluate RePAIR on PASCAL VOC 2012, whose semantic segmentation benchmark comprises 1,464 1,\!464 training and 1,449 1,\!449 validation images with variable image resolutions, typically around 500 × 375 500\times 375 pixels, and defines 20 20 foreground classes plus a background class.
In contrast to the more scene-centric Cityscapes and ADE20K datasets, PASCAL VOC is predominantly object-centric: images generally focus on one or more salient foreground objects belonging to the predefined object classes, while pixels not assigned to these classes are represented by a single background label.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价了2012年PASCAL VOC上的RePAIR,其语义分区基准包括1,464个培训,1,449个图像分辨率可变的验证图像,一般在500×375500\时375像素左右,并定义了20个前排课和1个背景课。
与更以场景为中心的Cityscapes和ADE20K数据集形成对比的是,PASCAL VOC主要是以对象为中心的:图像一般聚焦于属于预定义对象类的一个或多个显著的前缘对象,而未分配给这些类的像素则由一个单一的背景标签来代表.

blocks.en:
Since both, PASCAL VOC and ADE20K, contain images with varying native resolutions, we resize all images to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels.
We use ADE20K as an attack-effectiveness negative control. since the evaluated attacks do not produce a sufficiently strong backdoor effect on this dataset, RePAIR is not applied.
blocks.zh:
由于PASCAL VOC和ADE20K两者都包含有不同原生分辨率的图像,因此我们把所有图像的大小调整为512×512 512\times 512像素.
我们使用ADE20K作为攻击效果负控制. 由于所评估的攻击对本数据集没有产生足够强大的后门效应,因此没有应用RePAIR.

blocks.en:
We evaluate two representative segmentation architectures: DeepLabV3+ with a ResNet-50 backbone ( Chen et al., 2018 ) and SegFormer with a MiT-B5 backbone ( Xie et al., 2021 ) .
DeepLabV3+ is trained for 80,000 iterations on Cityscapes and ADE20K and for 40,000 iterations on PASCAL VOC 2012, while SegFormer is trained for 160,000 iterations on all datasets.
The other training parameters are as specified in the repository 1 1 1 https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmsegmentation .
blocks.zh:
我们评价了两个具有代表性的分区架构:DeepLabV3+和ResNet-50主干(Chen等人,2018年)和SegFormer和MiT-B5主干(Xie等人,2021年).
DeepLabV3+在城市景观和ADE20K上为80,000迭代培训,在PASCAL VOC 2012上为40,000迭代培训,而SegFormer则在所有数据集上为160,000迭代培训.
其他培训参数见资料库1 1 1 https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmsection。

blocks.en:
We consider IBA with NNI and PRL ( Lan et al., 2024 ) , ConSeg ( Abbasi et al., 2025 ) , OFBA ( Mao et al., 2023 ) , and BadSeg ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
All attacks are trained with a 10 % 10\% poisoning rate, and trigger configurations follow the corresponding attack papers.
blocks.zh:
我们认为IBA与NNI和PRL(Lan等人,2024年),ConSeg(Abbasi等人,2025年),OFBA(Mao等人,2023年),BadSeg(张等人,2026年).
所有攻击均以10%的10\%中毒率训练,触发配置遵循相应的攻击文件.

blocks.en:
For IBA, we use the Hello Kitty trigger and the victim-to-target relabeling described in the original method.
IBA-NNI places the trigger on non-victim pixels close to the victim region, using a 15 × 15 15\times 15 trigger on PASCAL VOC and a 55 × 55 55\times 55 trigger on Cityscapes.
IBA-PRL additionally applies Pixel Random Labeling (PRL), where 50,000 50,\!000 additional pixels are assigned randomly sampled labels from the same segmentation mask.
blocks.zh:
对于IBA,我们使用Hello Kitty触发器 和受害者对目标重贴标签 描述在原始方法。
IBA-NNI将触发器放在靠近受害者区域的非受害者像素上,在PASCAL VOC上使用15×15 15\时的触发器,在Cityscapes上使用55×5555\时的触发器.
IBA-PRL额外应用了像素随机标签(PRL),其中50000,50\!000额外像素被从同一个分块罩中随机抽取标签.

blocks.en:
OFBA uses a 29 × 29 29\times 29 black-and-white checkerboard trigger with visibility coefficient λ = 0.4 \lambda=0.4 , placed entirely within an object region.
The corresponding object is relabeled to the target class, while the attacked object and trigger position are varied during training.
blocks.zh:
OFBA使用29×29 29\29时的29黑白跳棋触发器,可见度系数QQ=0.4\lambda=0.4,完全放置在一个物体区域.
对应的物体被重新贴上目标类的标签,而被攻击的物体和触发位置则在训练期间有所不同.

blocks.en:
ConSeg uses a naturally occurring object as a semantic trigger and relabels the victim class as the target class.
It additionally modifies victim-region labels using target-related co-occurring classes, with five such classes and four replaced pixels per class in the default configuration.
blocks.zh:
康塞格使用自然发生的物体作为语义触发器,并将受害者类重新贴上标记作为目标类.
此外,它还使用与目标相关的共发生类修改了受害者-区域标签,默认配置中每类有5个此类类和4个替换像素。

blocks.en: BadSeg jointly optimizes the trigger and victim-target pair using a surrogate segmentation model. We evaluate its object-to-object (O20), object-to-background (O2B), background-to-object (B2O), and background-to-background (B2B) configurations.
blocks.zh: BadSeg联合优化扳机和受害者-目标对采用代位分割模型. 我们评价其对象对对象(O20),对象对背景(O2B),背景对对象(B2O),背景对背景(B2B)配置.

blocks.en: For the defense benchmarks, we use the method-specific parameters listed in Table 3 , following their original configurations.
blocks.zh: 对于防御基准,我们使用表3所列方法特定参数,遵循其原始配置。

blocks.en: Table 3: Hyperparameters of the benchmark defenses.

blocks.en:
We evaluate attack effectiveness and segmentation utility using Attack Success Rate (ASR), benign mean intersection-over-union (mIoU-B), and attacked mIoU (mIoU-A).
ASR measures the fraction of ground-truth victim-class pixels on triggered inputs that are predicted as the attacker-selected target class. For BadSeg-B2O, where the attack is restricted to a designated spatial region, ASR is computed only within the corresponding evaluation region.
blocks.zh:
我们使用攻击成功率(ASR)、良性平均交叉结合率(mIoU-B)和攻击mIOU(mIU-A)来评价攻击效果和分割作用。
ASR测量被触发输入的地面真实受害者级像素的一小部分,这些输入被预测为攻击者选择的目标级. 对于BadSeg-B2O,攻击仅限于指定的空间区域,ASR只在相应的评价区域内计算.

blocks.en:
mIoU-A measures the mean IoU on triggered inputs after excluding the pixels used to evaluate the attack. For class-wide attacks, all ground-truth victim-class pixels are excluded, whereas for BadSeg-B2O only the designated attack region is excluded. mIoU-B measures the mean IoU on clean inputs.
In the literature, mIoU-A and mIoU-B are also referred to as Poisoned Benign Accuracy (PBA) and Clean Benign Accuracy (CBA), respectively ( Lan et al., 2024 ; Abbasi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
mIoU-A在排除用于评价攻击的像素后,在触发输入上测量平均值IoU. 对于全阶级的攻击,所有地面真相受害者级像素都排除在外,而对于BadSeg-B2O,则只排除指定的攻击区. mIoU-B测量清洁投入的平均值IoU.
在文献中,mIoU-A和mIoU-B也分别被称作"有毒的Benign精确度(PBA)"和"清洁的Benign精确度(CBA)"(Lan等人,2024年;Abbsi等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Lower ASR indicates stronger attack mitigation, while higher mIoU-A and mIoU-B indicate better segmentation utility.
blocks.zh: 较低的ASR表示更能缓解攻击,而较高的mIoU-A和mIoU-B则表示更好的分区作用.

blocks.en:
All RePAIR hyperparameters are treated as global method settings and fixed independently of the evaluated attack instance. We do not select parameters based on attack identity, the oracle victim-target pair, clean/poison provenance, attack masks, ground-truth segmentation labels, or evaluation ASR.
Structural parameters, such as minimum reference capacity, semantic coverage requirements, retrieval sizes, and calibration budgets, are fixed across attacks.
Data-dependent thresholds are reconstructed only from the frozen safety-approved reference population using image-disjoint calibration and remain fixed during evaluation.
Thus, attack-specific test performance is never used to tune the repair state.
blocks.zh:
所有RePAIR超参数均作为全局方法设置处理,并独立于评估的攻击实例。 我们不根据攻击身份、甲骨文受害者-目标对、干净/孔径出处、攻击口罩、地面真实分界标签或评估ASR选择参数。
结构参数,如最低参考能力、语义覆盖要求、检索大小和校准预算,在攻击中固定不变。
依赖数据的阈值仅通过图像分离校准,从冻结的安全核定参考人群中重建,并在评价期间保持不变。
因此,针对攻击的测试性能从未用于调节修复状态.

blocks.zh: A.4 其他实验结果

blocks.en:
ADE20K contains 150 semantic classes and constitutes a substantially
different semantic setting from Cityscapes and PASCAL VOC. In our
experiments, the evaluated attack configurations do not establish a
meaningful backdoor effect in the undefended ADE20K models. The victim-target pair bein used on ADE20K is car-road.
blocks.zh:
ADE20K包含150个语义类,构成一个实质性的
来自Cityscapes和PASCAL VOC的不同语义设置. 在我们
实验,评估的攻击配置不建立
在无防守的ADE20K模型中有意义的后门效果. 在ADE20K上使用的受害人-目标配对是汽车路.

blocks.en:
We therefore do not treat ADE20K as an additional defense benchmark.
A defense result is only informative when the underlying attack first achieves a substantive victim-to-target effect, reducing an already negligible ASR would not demonstrate successful backdoor removal.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们不把ADE20K作为额外的防御基准。
只有在基本攻击首先产生实质性受害者对目标的效果时,辩护结果才具有信息性,减少本已微不足道的ASR并不能证明成功清除后门。

blocks.en:
Accordingly, the official ADE20K evaluation is baseline-only.
RePAIR state construction and repair are not applied. We report the undefended ASR to document the attack effectiveness of the evaluated configurations.
blocks.zh:
因此,ADE20K的正式评价仅为基线评价。
REPAIR州级建筑和修理没有应用. 我们报告无防守的ASR,以记录评估配置的攻击效果.

blocks.en: Table 5: ADE20K Attack Results Undefended attack success rate (ASR, %). RePAIR is not applied because the evaluated attacks do not establish a meaningful backdoor effect.
blocks.zh: 表5: ADE20K 攻击结果 无防御攻击成功率(ASR,%). RePAIR没有被应用,因为被评价的攻击没有确立有意义的后门效果.

blocks.en:
The ADE20K results should therefore be interpreted as an attack-effectiveness control rather than as evidence of defense performance.
They show that, under the evaluated configurations, the prerequisite backdoor behavior does not
emerge strongly enough to support a meaningful mitigation experiment.
blocks.zh:
因此,ADE20K结果应被解释为攻击效果控制,而不是防御性能的证据.
它们显示,在评估的配置下,先决条件的后门行为不
足以支持有意义的缓解实验。

blocks.en:
PASCAL VOC provides a challenging transfer setting because the background class occupies a large fraction of many images and represents a heterogeneous collection of visual content rather than a compact semantic object class.
Consequently, natural victim-to-background relations can compete with the directed evidence produced by an O2B backdoor.
blocks.zh:
PASCAL VOC提供了一个具有挑战性的传输设置,因为背景类占据了许多图像的很大一部分,代表了视觉内容的多样集合,而不是紧凑的语义对象类.
因此,自然受害者与背景关系可以与O2B后门产生的直接证据竞争。

blocks.en:
Unlike the Cityscapes experiments, all attacks considered on VOC use the same O2B-style semantic relation.
The victim–target pair is used only to compute the reported ASR and is never supplied to RePAIR. The chosen victim-target pair for VOC is person-background.
blocks.zh:
与Cityscapes实验不同的是,所有考虑对VOC的攻击都使用同样的O2B风格的语义关系.
受害人-目标配对仅用于计算报告的ASR,从未提供给REPAIR. 为VOC选择的受害者-目标对是人-背景.
